summary: In src/click/core.py, Option.get_error_hint now appends the env var hint only when self.show_envvar and self.envvar are truthy; a str envvar becomes a one-item list, otherwise the sequence is used, and each variable is quoted and joined with ", ", with a comment noting names may contain spaces or commas on any platform. Option.get_help_extra merges the auto-prefix check into one condition using `not envvar`, so an empty envvar behaves like None, and extra["envvars"] is only set when envvar is truthy. CHANGES.md gained two bullets under Unreleased, both ending in {pr}`3884`. All 676 tests in tests/test_options.py pass.
concerns: Whether the truthiness checks match the intended semantics for non-str, non-sequence envvar values
Whether CHANGES.md wording/placement matches the project's bullet conventions
